rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a blastocyst showing a visible cavity and zona, but it overstates confidence in identifying a strong ICM/TE from this soft-focus single image and questions expansion despite the provided Gardner 3AA grade.
Integrates age, ovarian response, diagnosis, BMI, semen parameters, endometrium, and prior IVF history well, with reasonable discussion of how these affect prognosis alongside embryo quality.

Reasoning is structured and mostly internally consistent, with a plausible probability range tied to embryo quality and patient factors; only minor overemphasis on image-based downgrading and alcohol impact.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice: SET for a good-quality day-5 blastocyst, avoid unnecessary add-ons after one failure, consider selective PGT-A, and optimize lifestyle; a few points are more advisory than guideline-based.
Provides clear next steps for current transfer and contingency planning for future cycles, including SET, lifestyle changes, luteal support review, and measured escalation if unsuccessful.
